findings.title: Reflected XSS in /page solution parameter — CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: The /page endpoint accepts a POST parameter 'solution' that is reflected unsanitized into the HTML response. Submitting a <script>alert('XSS')</script> payload triggers the challenge and returns the CTF flag. The application uses Flask/Werkzeug and does not sanitize or encode user input before reflecting it in the page.
findings.evidence: POST /page with body solution=<script>alert('XSS')</script> returned HTTP 200 with body: Congratulations! Here is the flag: flag{b74b5516-3dc3-491e-8680-a01ab52b756c}
